title: Weight-Space Programming Writes In-Context Learning and Matches Fine-Tuning in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26841v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight-space programming is a frontier language model's recently reported ability to read and rewrite another network's weights without gradient descent. We investigate how examples can provide a weight update so that a weaker language model performs the task with nothing in the prompt, and study what it edits. Our experiments cover six tasks, four frontier editors and three families of weaker language models, without the editors being told anything about in-context learning (ICL). In most runs, the few-shot minus zero-shot residual is measured at the final prompt token, the ICL task vector, and write it into the weights, at its sparsest into near-silent MLP units keyed to the prompt format. Results reach the accuracy of ICL and of fine-tuning on the same examples, LoRA included, usually leaving perplexity untouched, with worse performance under changes of wording. translated_title: 权重空间编程可写入上下文学习并在语言模型中媲美微调
translated_abstract: 权重空间编程是前沿语言模型最近被报道的一种能力：它无需梯度下降即可读取并改写另一个网络的权重。我们研究示例如何能以权重更新的形式提供信息，使较弱的语言模型在提示为空的情况下完成任务，并探究编辑模型究竟改写了什么。实验涵盖六项任务、四个前沿编辑模型以及三族较弱的语言模型，且没有向编辑模型透露任何关于上下文学习（ICL）的信息。在大多数运行中，编辑模型在最后一个提示 token 处测量少样本减零样本的残差，即 ICL 任务向量，并将其写入权重之中，最稀疏的情况下会写入与提示格式相关联的近乎沉默的 MLP 单元。所得结果达到了 ICL 以及微调（包括 LoRA）在相同示例上的准确率，通常几乎不改变困惑度，但在措辞发生变化时性能会有所下降。我们还通过统计未完成的运行来限定这一比较，观察到……
tldr: 前沿语言模型可通过权重空间编程将ICL任务向量直接写入较弱模型的稀疏MLP单元（与提示格式相关联），使其零样本性能达到ICL和微调（含LoRA）的准确率，且几乎不影响困惑度。
en_tdlr: Frontier language models can program another model's weights directly, writing the ICL task vector into sparse, prompt-format-keyed MLP units, enabling the weaker model to match ICL and fine-tuning (including LoRA) accuracy with little change in perplexity.
